english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person who presents radio or television programmes.
This is the all-purpose term for a person who hosts a broadcast programme.
Use this specifically for the person who hosts or emcees a show or performance.

examples.english: The broadcaster is hosting the news programme today.
examples.traditional: 主持人今日主持新聞節目。
